import sys

MOD = 998244353

def power(base, exp, mod):
    result = 1
    base = base % mod
    while exp > 0:
        if exp % 2 == 1:
            result = (result * base) % mod
        exp = exp >> 1
        base = (base * base) % mod
    return result

n = int(sys.stdin.read().strip())
total_ways = power(2, n * (n - 1) // 2, MOD)
valid_ways = (total_ways - 2) % MOD
print(valid_ways)
